title: Show who and what changed code may affect

steps.action: Compare a source change inside code owned by a requirement Item and test case.
steps.expected_result: The impact result lists the implicated criterion, test case, story, and active persona reached through recorded edges.

steps.action: Compare a source change with no recorded owner.
steps.expected_result: The change remains visible as unowned and no requirement or persona is fabricated.

steps.action: Project an active persona that no accepted story serves.
steps.expected_result: The persona is reported as a visible nonblocking gap.

expected_result: Changed owned code names implicated requirements and personas, unowned code remains visible, and an active persona without an accepted story is a gap.
